labels.justification: The clause mentions using automated tools to detect violations, which relates to security safeguards but lacks specific technical measures like encryption or obfuscation.
The clause discusses sending communications but does not explicitly mention informing Data Principals of the purpose of processing.
The clause mentions sending messages but does not clearly describe the personal data and the purpose of its processing.
The clause does not meaningfully address any listed requirement in the taxonomy.
The clause mentions breach notification but does not provide a detailed description of the breach as required.
The clause mentions asking for permission but does not explicitly inform Data Principals of the consequences of withdrawal.
